name: @keeratita/card
description: Translucent iOS-style credit card input form and direct REST tokenization package for Stripe and Omise.

scripts.build: ngc -p tsconfig.ngc.partial.json && tsup && node scripts/generate-dist-package-json.js && node scripts/ship-angular-partial.js && sass --no-source-map src/vanilla/styles.scss dist/vanilla/styles.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/vanilla/styles.scss dist/vanilla/styles.min.css
scripts.build:vanilla: tsup --no-clean src/vanilla/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --out-dir dist/vanilla && sass --no-source-map src/vanilla/styles.scss dist/vanilla/styles.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/vanilla/styles.scss dist/vanilla/styles.min.css
scripts.build:angular: ngc -p tsconfig.ngc.partial.json && tsup --no-clean src/angular/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --external @angular/core,@angular/forms --out-dir dist/angular && node scripts/ship-angular-partial.js
scripts.demo:react: npm run build && npm run dev -w @keeratita/card-react-examples
scripts.demo:angular: npm run build && npm run start -w @keeratita/card-angular-examples
scripts.demo:all: npm run build && (npm run dev -w @keeratita/card-react-examples &) && (npm run start -w @keeratita/card-angular-examples &)
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm publish --access public

author: Keerati Tansawatcharoen <keerati.tansawatcharoen@gmail.com>
